manual_102.topic: Free garage + free car from Boobie's apartment: laptop in the bedroom, password Muffins-Queen-15, WhatUp chat from Unknown leads to a locked garage next to Auntie's Place in La Perle, keypad code 92665 unlocks Vanessa's Growler

Rockstar hid a free garage and a free car in GTA 6. In Boobie's apartment, open the bedroom laptop: the password is Muffins-Queen-15. Read the WhatUp chat from Unknown, go to the locked garage next to Auntie's Place in La Perle and enter 92665: Vanessa's Growler is yours.

manual_103.topic: 4 GTA 6 settings to change: subtitles (Mission Only by default, set to all dialogue in the UI tab), Camera Bob (10 → 3-5), Motion Blur under Display (0-1), Camera Shake off in the Camera tab
manual_103.title: Change these 4 GTA 6 settings NOW ⚙️ (#1 fixes every chase) | غيّر هالـ4 إعدادات في GTA 6 الحين ⚙️
manual_103.title_en: Change these 4 GTA 6 settings NOW ⚙️ (#1 fixes every chase)
manual_103.title_ar: غيّر هالـ4 إعدادات في GTA 6 الحين ⚙️
manual_103.caption:
Change these 4 GTA 6 settings NOW ⚙️ (#1 fixes every chase) | غيّر هالـ4 إعدادات في GTA 6 الحين ⚙️

4 GTA 6 settings to change first: subtitles only show in missions, so set them to all dialogue in the UI tab; drop Camera Bob from 10 to 3-5; slide Motion Blur (Display) to 0 or 1; and turn Camera Shake off in the Camera tab so chases are far easier to follow.
